name: Decode raw data into data value(s)
description: The process of interpreting a sequence of bytes as a typed value, such as a number, a string, or a date, under an assumed encoding.
details:
Decoding is performed inside many other techniques rather than as a separate examination step, which is why its failures are currently recorded against whichever technique consumed the value. This provides a generic version of the technique. 

Related techniques that depend on it include DFT-1191 (Parse allocated structures in Windows HIVE files), DFT-1071 (Extract data from SQLite database(s)) and DFT-1121 (Index a data source for keyword searching). DFT-1044 and DFT-1102 decode specific container formats rather than typed values.
